jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Overview

At RealPage, we're transforming property management through software that makes operations effortless, residents happier, and growth easier for our customers. As Director of Engineering for Buildium, a RealPage company, you won't just maintain systems you'll shape the next generation of core solutions and services that power how property managers run their businesses.

Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you'll lead multiple engineering teams building mission-critical systems for Buildium's core platform, including our AI-driven capabilities. You'll partner closely with Product, UX, and QA to raise the bar on execution, quality, and team effectiveness while delivering scalable, intelligent solutions at enterprise scale.

Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership & Delivery

Own delivery outcomes for assigned product and platform areas, ensuring commitments are realistic, predictable, and aligned with business priorities.
Lead and manage multiple engineering teams (up to ~7 direct reports, including managers and senior engineers) across onshore, near-shore, and off-shore locations.
Partner closely with Product leadership and stakeholders to develop and manage 12+ month strategic roadmapsaligned to business goals.
Manage all aspects of assigned initiatives, from business case development through QA sign-off and release readiness.
Ensure delivery against schedule and budget while balancing scope, quality, and technical risk.

Distributed Team Leadership

Provide effective leadership across global engineering teams, including offshore development organizations.
Establish clear ownership, communication rhythms, and escalation paths to ensure alignment across time zones.
Build strong working relationships with regional leaders to ensure consistency in execution, standards, and expectations.
Foster a culture of accountability, trust, inclusion, and continuous improvement across distributed teams.

Technical Oversight & Quality

Oversee the design, development, and implementation of enterprise-scale software products and systems.
Ensure teams adhere to strong engineering fundamentals, including code quality, testing discipline, observability, operational readiness, and security.
Lead technical analysis and design reviews to translate business and functional requirements into scalable software solutions.
Act as an escalation point for complex technical issues, ensuring root causes are addressed and long-term improvements are implemented.
Partner with Architecture to align platform direction, system design, and implementation practices.

Operational Excellence & Process

Develop, administer, and continuously improve engineering processes and standards within the assigned functional area.
Identify and drive process improvement initiatives to increase delivery predictability, quality, and efficiency.
Ensure unit, integration, and system test coverage expectations are met and enforced.
Conduct in-process reviews and ensure quality gates are consistently applied.
Support release cycles, including flexibility to work extended hours during critical delivery periods as needed.

Cross-Functional & Vendor Collaboration

Consult with management and stakeholders to analyze potential projects, determine scope and priorities, and resolve customer or operational issues.
Manage relationships with internal teams across RealPage to support system design, integration, and delivery.
Negotiate and coordinate with consultants, vendors, and external partners as needed to support product development and delivery.
Ensure appropriate documentation, internal enablement, and end-user training materials are delivered as part of releases.

People & Talent Development

Build, coach, and retain high-performing engineering leaders and teams.
Set clear performance expectations and provide ongoing feedback, coaching, and career development.
Identify skill gaps, succession risks, and capacity constraints and proactively address them through hiring, development, or rebalancing.
Promote a culture of ownership, accountability, and data-driven decision-making.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field—or equivalent industry experience.
12+ years of software development experience, with 7+ years in engineering leadership roles, including managing managers and Directors.
Proven experience leading large, distributed engineering organizations across multiple teams and domains.
Demonstrated success delivering enterprise-scale, multi-team software platforms in a SaaS environment.
Strong understanding of modern SDLC practices, Agile methodologies, and large-scale software delivery.
Experience operating in polyglot environments, with exposure to:
C#, ASP.NET / MVC
SQL and relational databases
JavaScript, HTML5, CSS

Strong business and technical acumen, with the ability to connect engineering execution to business outcomes.
Excellent communication, leadership, and influencing skills across technical and executive audiences.

Preferred Skills

Experience managing products or platforms spanning multiple systems or technology stacks.
Background in SaaS, enterprise software, or regulated environments.
Familiarity with integrations, event-driven systems, or platform ecosystems.
Experience supporting insurance, screening, or financial services-related products.
Exposure to AI-enabled systems or intelligent automation is a plus.

Salary And Benefits

RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:
Health, dental, and vision insurance.
Retirement savings plan with company match.
Paid time off and holidays.
Professional development opportunities.
Performance-based bonus based on position.

Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance.

Equal Opportunity Employer: RealPage Company is an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

At AdRise, we build cutting-edge advertising capabilities for Tubi and across the Fox portfolio of brands across Sports, Entertainment and News, and including Fox One, the new direct to consumer streaming service.

Before streaming became industry standard, AdRise powered Tubi's growth from the ground up by developing real-time ad delivery and dynamic targeting infrastructure that scaled to serve hundreds of millions. That same tech foundation is now fueling FOX's cross-portfolio monetization strategy. Put simply, we are creating the most efficient, intelligent, and transparent advertising ecosystem in the world, starting with streaming.

We are enhancing the in-house ad tech stack by optimizing server-side delivery, building ML-driven targeting systems, and enabling content-personalized ad experiences that respond to what viewers actually watch. From real-time decisioning to data collaboration with AWS and Databricks, we are creating a smarter, more dynamic ad tech ecosystem. The problems are complex, the visibility is high, and the platform is built for impact. If you want to work at the center of streaming monetization on systems that touch hundreds of billions of impressions and shape the next generation of personalized advertising, this is your platform.

ABOUT THE ROLE

AdRise is looking for a Director of Engineering to lead Rainmaker, our Ad Server engineering domain responsible for the core systems that decide, deliver, and govern advertising across our streaming ecosystem. This domain sits at the heart of monetization and is accountable for business-critical systems that must be fast, reliable, scalable, and operationally excellent.

In this role, you will own a major engineering domain portfolio and be accountable for multi-quarter results across delivery, reliability, and technical health. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, ML, Ads Operations, and platform partners to evolve our ad serving capabilities and execution model.

This role requires strong engineering judgment and organizational leadership. You will set direction for the domain, make investment tradeoffs across product delivery and platform sustainability, establish a high bar for quality and operational rigor, and build a healthy organization that can scale with the business.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead the Rainmaker Ad Server engineering team, setting clear technical direction, team priorities, and execution standards across a high-scale, low-latency ad serving platform
Own the engineering strategy and roadmap for ad serving capabilities, balancing near-term business commitments with long-term platform health, scalability, and maintainability.
Partner with Product, Data Science, ML, and adjacent engineering teams to translate business goals into durable technical investments that improve delivery quality, monetization efficiency, and advertiser outcomes.
Drive the architecture and evolution of distributed systems that power ad decisioning, auction logic, targeting, eligibility, pacing integrations, and serving reliability at large scale.
Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization by coaching managers and senior engineers, growing staff-level leadership, and creating clarity in roles, expectations, and career development.
Establish a high bar for engineering excellence through strong design reviews, operational rigor, observability, incident management, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Improve team execution by strengthening planning, prioritization, delivery predictability, and cross-functional alignment across multiple stakeholders and dependencies.
Identify architectural bottlenecks, organizational friction, and process gaps, then lead pragmatic changes that increase velocity without compromising system correctness or reliability.
Champion modernization where it matters, whether through platform simplification, performance optimization, infrastructure improvements, or better developer workflows.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

10+ years of experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, with substantial experience in backend infrastructure and real-time services.
5+ years of engineering leadership experience, including managing senior engineers and engineering managers in high-performing technical organizations.
Strong technical depth in low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems, with the ability to guide architecture and make sound tradeoffs in performance, reliability, scalability, and developer velocity.
Experience leading teams responsible for business-critical production systems with demanding uptime and performance requirements.
Strong background with JVM-based backend systems, ideally Scala, with fluency in modern service-oriented architecture and distributed systems design.
Experience with core backend infrastructure such as Postgres, Redis, Kafka and/or Kinesis, and cloud-native operational environments.
Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, ML, and other engineering teams to deliver complex, multi-team initiatives.
Track record of building strong teams, mentoring senior engineers, and creating environments where technical leaders can thrive.
Strong operational instincts, including experience driving incident response, service reliability improvements, and engineering process maturity.
High ownership, sound judgment, and a pragmatic approach to balancing technical quality with business impact

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Experience in AdTech, including ad serving, targeting, auction systems, campaign delivery, forecasting, or measurement.
Experience leading teams responsible for core ad decisioning or monetization infrastructure.
Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, and related infrastructure and deployment tooling in large-scale production environments.
Familiarity with experimentation frameworks, real-time optimization systems, and data-intensive platforms used to improve serving decisions and monetization outcomes.
Experience operating in streaming media, CTV, video advertising, or other high-scale consumer platforms.

jobs.description:
About The Team

The Tax Technology team owns the technology behind what happens on our platform. We build and run the systems that calculate indirect tax on every transaction — and we go well beyond that. We build the automations and implementations the direct tax team relies on, we support data operations across the tax function, and we develop the tooling and efficiencies that make the wider Tax Force faster. We are a global team spanning three brands: DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.

That reach also makes us one of the most dependency-heavy systems in the company. More than eight separate billing domains feed into our tax services, each with its own architecture, roadmap, and engineering team — and all of them have to work.

Getting this right is not optional. Tax has to be correct on every order, the first time. Getting it wrong means incorrect charges to real customers, restatement risk, and audit exposure. We are looking for someone who can hold the whole picture and make it land.

About The Role

The Senior Manager, Tax Technology Implementations reports to the Director of Tax Technology and owns the technical implementation plan between the various domains and our indirect tax calculation service.

You have a deep understanding of the indirect Tax subject matter and also the technical partner to the engineering team. You will translate indirect tax requirements into things engineers can build, and you will own the single consolidated plan that tells Tax and Engineering leadership where the program actually stands.

You will influence partner teams with your understanding of the problem and source of truth of a trusted plan. You make it easy for partner teams to do the right thing.

This role owns the tax outcome of implementations— the requirements, the design judgment, and the technical calls that determine whether it works.

Requirements and design.
Author tax requirements and acceptance criteria that engineers build against and that hold up under audit. Review design docs and push back where a design won't scale to the tax rules coming.

Scope and sequencing.
Define what's in and out for each integration, own the critical path, and drive what ships when. When a team slips, know within a day what it means downstream — and bring options.

Roadmap influence.
Get tax work prioritized onto eight other teams' roadmaps and defend it when it's bumped — making this a collaboration between the engineering, product teams and tax.

Launch and operational readiness.
Define testing, monitoring, and rollout, set go/no-go and rollback criteria, and make sure each integration lands with runbooks, alerting, and a clear steady-state owner.

Risk.
Own the risk register and escalate with a recommendation attached. Be the person who saw it coming.

Running the program.
Maintain the integrated plan as the source of truth and keep the decision cadence across Tax, Product, Engineering, and Data — reporting status to senior leadership in a format they trust.

Have visibility across the entire business, solving genuinely complex problems across many domains with both engineering and non-engineering partners.

Work closely with engineers to shape design decisions, not just receive them.

ML & Data Engineering

Technical Ownership: Operate as a self-directed contributor who scopes, plans, and drives initiatives end-to-end — translating ambiguous Quality problems into technical solutions, making sound architectural trade-offs, and delivering production outcomes with minimal oversight.
Infrastructure & Environment Automation: Independently provision and manage cloud infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and containerization, standing up reproducible, scalable environments for training, serving, and experimentation with minimal reliance on external teams.
Model Lifecycle Management: Develop and maintain pipelines to transition models from experimentation to production, including packaging, CI/CD, automated testing, and deployment. Support model serving for Quality use cases such as signal detection, risk analytics, and Quality Performance/Quality Health models.
Data Pipeline Development: Design robust batch and streaming data workflows; integrate, define, and manage feature sets, lineage, and reuse across QMS data sources (e.g., Audit, Deviation, CAPA, Risk Management).
Data Orchestration: Author and schedule reliable, observable workflows using orchestration tools and distributed processing, ensuring dependencies, retries, and SLAs are handled without manual intervention.
Production Operations & Monitoring: Ensure the reliability and scalability of data pipelines; implement effective logging, tracing, and alerting. Establish monitoring for model performance, data drift, bias, and service health, paying particular attention to data quality across QMS data feeds, where low-frequency quality signals amplify the impact of anomalies.

AI & Agent Systems Support

Efficiency & Optimization: Where AI tooling is used, apply sensible practices to manage context usage and cost, balancing capability with available budget.

Significant hands-on experience operationalizing data/ML solutions end-to-end, including data engineering, pipeline development, deployment, and production monitoring.

new_jobs.description:
About The Team

The Tax Technology team owns the technology behind what happens on our platform. We build and run the systems that calculate indirect tax on every transaction — and we go well beyond that. We build the automations and implementations the direct tax team relies on, we support data operations across the tax function, and we develop the tooling and efficiencies that make the wider Tax Force faster. We are a global team spanning three brands: DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.

That reach also makes us one of the most dependency-heavy systems in the company. More than eight separate billing domains feed into our tax services, each with its own architecture, roadmap, and engineering team — and all of them have to work.

Getting this right is not optional. Tax has to be correct on every order, the first time. Getting it wrong means incorrect charges to real customers, restatement risk, and audit exposure. We are looking for someone who can hold the whole picture and make it land.

About The Role

The Senior Manager, Tax Technology Implementations reports to the Director of Tax Technology and owns the technical implementation plan between the various domains and our indirect tax calculation service.

You have a deep understanding of the indirect Tax subject matter and also the technical partner to the engineering team. You will translate indirect tax requirements into things engineers can build, and you will own the single consolidated plan that tells Tax and Engineering leadership where the program actually stands.

You will influence partner teams with your understanding of the problem and source of truth of a trusted plan. You make it easy for partner teams to do the right thing.

This role owns the tax outcome of implementations— the requirements, the design judgment, and the technical calls that determine whether it works.

Requirements and design.
Author tax requirements and acceptance criteria that engineers build against and that hold up under audit. Review design docs and push back where a design won't scale to the tax rules coming.

Scope and sequencing.
Define what's in and out for each integration, own the critical path, and drive what ships when. When a team slips, know within a day what it means downstream — and bring options.

Roadmap influence.
Get tax work prioritized onto eight other teams' roadmaps and defend it when it's bumped — making this a collaboration between the engineering, product teams and tax.

Launch and operational readiness.
Define testing, monitoring, and rollout, set go/no-go and rollback criteria, and make sure each integration lands with runbooks, alerting, and a clear steady-state owner.

Risk.
Own the risk register and escalate with a recommendation attached. Be the person who saw it coming.

Running the program.
Maintain the integrated plan as the source of truth and keep the decision cadence across Tax, Product, Engineering, and Data — reporting status to senior leadership in a format they trust.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

Have visibility across the entire business, solving genuinely complex problems across many domains with both engineering and non-engineering partners.
Own an end-to-end program rather than a slice of one, with real consequences and real scope.
Work closely with engineers to shape design decisions, not just receive them.
Build the connective tissue for a program that spans three brands and multiple jurisdictions.
Be supported by Anthropics Claude suite of tooling and an extensive tax data mart to speed up analysis, planning, and daily operations.
Grow a team and a function that is still being defined.

We're excited about you because…

8+ years in a corporate tax department, public accounting, or technology consulting
Global or multi-country indirect tax implementation experience, and familiarity with non-US indirect tax regimes.
Hands-on experience implementing Marketplace Facilitator laws across jurisdictions.
Program or project management experience across multiple dependent engineering teams, including building plans, milestones, and dependency maps, and driving them to completion.
Direct engagement with engineering teams on product development, with working knowledge of software development processes. You can read a technical design document and tell whether it will hold.
Experience defining testing and monitoring strategies for systems where correctness matters.
Strong analytical skills, high organization, and real attention to detail, with the ability to hold both the big picture and the specifics.
Comfort operating without formal authority in a highly collaborative, multi-stakeholder environment. You are not afraid to challenge the status quo, and you do it in a way that keeps partners on your side.

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing...

We are looking for a forward-thinking, hands-on Technical Product Development Manager to direct the growth and strategic expansion of our next-generation Network Automation. This role combines technical leadership with strategic business acumen to build and launch advanced AI products and enterprise services. The ideal candidate brings a comprehensive understanding of AI industry trends, commercial models, and corporate strategy, backed by deep expertise in AI architectures, model frameworks, and agentic systems. Strong familiarity with Edge computing, Cloud environments, Data Centers, and AI-focused NeoClouds is required.

Key requirements include hands-on expertise with agentic AI runtime infrastructure (such as AI Gateways, Routers, MCPs, and Semantic Caching) across Cloud, Edge, Data Center, and NeoCloud environments, along with a strong foundation in software-defined networking paradigms like SD-WAN and SASE.

Responsibilities Will Include

Network & AI Integration: Drive the convergence of enterprise WAN topologies—specifically SD-WAN and SASE frameworks—into a unified AI Fabric optimized for high-throughput, low-latency East-West and North-South traffic flows.
AI Agent Services: Architect and productize AI services, including AI Gateways, intelligent AI Routers, token brokering, token monitoring, standardized Model Context Protocols (MCPs) for context retrieval, and low-latency Semantic Caching layers.
Intelligent Network Automation & Evolution: Apply AI technologies to automate operations, optimize service delivery, and advance capabilities toward fully autonomous networks.
AI Platform Architecture: Demonstrated expertise in architecting and deploying scalable AI platform infrastructure to support agentic services. Proficient in agent identification, orchestration frameworks, as well as real-time intelligence and monitoring.
Lead end-to-end design and execution of AI Proof of Concepts (PoCs) in public cloud and lab environments.
Benchmark network performance, prompt/response latency, GPU utilization, and context-fabric efficiency under real-world AI inference and training workloads.
Formulate product roadmaps and commercial models based on deep market analysis of public hyperscalers, edge nodes, on-premise data centers, and GPU-first NeoClouds.
Monetize fabric capabilities by defining service levels (SLAs), enterprise security frameworks, and API/MCP integrations for autonomous agent workflows.

What We’re Looking For...

You’ll need to have:

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Five or more years of technical product management/development experience delivering enterprise-grade networking or AI software platforms.
Strong conceptual and technical foundation in DIA, EVPL, MPLS, SD-WAN, SASE, zero-trust security, or high-density data center network architectures.
Hands-on experience developing AI solutions across Edge, Cloud, traditional Data Centers, or specialized AI NeoClouds (GPU-as-a-Service).
Experience quickly prototyping, testing, and validating technical concepts in lab and multi-cloud environments before scaling to production.
Demonstrated success analyzing market trends and customer requirements to drive GTM strategy.
Willingness to travel up to 10%.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Knowledge of AI Gateways, AI Routers, vector/semantic caching mechanisms, and context standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
AI market trend analysis including unit economics (GPU/token costs), AI services, prices and GTM strategies.
Hands-on familiarity with agentic frameworks, knowledge graphs, and context retrieval pipelines.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Leads and oversees a department of over 100+ staff members and an operating budget of approximately $80M.In addition, oversees capital projects related to evolving information technology needs. Directs the delivery of information technology services to schools and offices for Baltimore County Public Schools (BCPS), including the learning management system, student information systems, web services, and business software.Position oversees data security, strategic technology planning, system-wide one on one computer initiative, disaster recovery planning, continuity of operations planning, e-rate program, systems integrity, applications programming and networking of voice, video, and data communications.Ensures that the department’s operations support the system-wide goals and priorities.Offices include Network Support Services, IT Operations, IT Security, Enterprise Solutions, and Enterprise Resource Planning.

Responsibilities

Provide leadership to set strategic technology direction and priorities for the school system. Provide administrative and instructional systems and infrastructure that are implemented and maintained to meet internal organizational requirements.
Establish and monitor controls to evaluate performance in meeting program, budget, and school system objectives.
Collaborate with schools, offices, and divisions to ensure the effective implementation of technology across the school system; manage multiple complex initiatives and achieve results within established cost, schedule, functionality, performance, and quality requirements.
Manage and develop Department of Information Technology staff and foster effective partnerships with vendors, schools, offices, and divisions. Promote a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and modernization through technical training, professional development, knowledge sharing, and best practices.
Implement data security, system analysis, design, development, testing, and quality assurance methodologies.
Advise executive leadership regarding technology strategy, emerging technologies, cybersecurity risks, and technology investment priorities.
Lead the development, refinement and integration of BCPS’ Digital Ecosystem in Student Information, Learning Management, Professional Learning, Digital Content, Instructional Tools, and Employee Effectiveness.
Ensure learning technology interoperability standards for data security, web accessibility, integration, rostering, and analytics are applied.
Supervise staff and communicate effectively while establishing and maintaining effective working relationships. Ensure and maintain confidential information.
Supervise large scale initiatives while effectively handling multiple implementation projects.
Oversee a variety of technology architectures including web-based, cloud, client/server, centralized, and distributed computing models.
Provide knowledge of vendor management and large-scale software package implementation. Identify and analyze new technologies, systems, and applications to determine requirement, compliance and system compatibility.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education, Training and Experience:

Master’s degree from an accredited college or university.
Master’s degree with an emphasis on information technology, public administration or a related field preferred.
Eight years of related experience with at least five years managing information technology systems.
Information technology experience in a public education setting is preferred.

Note: Other combination of applicable education, training, and experience which provide the knowledge, skills and abilities necessary to perform effectively in the position, may be considered.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Thorough knowledge of IT systems engineering, design, development, and support.
Thorough knowledge of computer operations, programming, and systems analysis in a large SQL, or equivalent environment.
Thorough knowledge of the systems development life cycle (SDLC).
Knowledge of personal computers and office software applications.
Knowledge of presentation software applications.
Thorough knowledge of contract and vendor management.
Skill in planning IT initiatives and analyzing their strategic business impact.
Demonstration of outstanding oral and written communications skills.
Demonstration of strong leadership and management skills.
Strong technical, process improvement, team building, human relations, organization and computer skills.
Skill in public speaking.
Skill in the use of personal computers and office software applications.
Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships.
Skill in serving as a liaison.
Ability to identify and manage technology trends and their impact on business strategies and goals.
Ability to manage challenges in a large public-sector setting.
Ability to drive enterprise technology objectives.
Ability to provide leadership, guidance, and coordination for major system-wide initiatives.
Ability to coordinate the activities of departments.
Ability to maintain sensitive and confidential information.
Ability to supervise staff.
Ability to communicate effectively.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships.
Ability to handle confidential information effectively.
Ability to supervise staff members.
Ability to supervise large scale initiatives.
Ability to multi-task and handle multiple implementation projects at one time.
